versions.subject: rule: missing space characters
versions.detection:
selection1:  # missing space before the /c
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'cmd.exe/c'
        - '\cmd/c'  # just cmd/c would be prone to false positives 
selection2: # special cases verified via Virustotal Enterprise search
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/cwhoami'
        - '/cpowershell'
        - '/cschtasks'
        - '/cbitsadmin'
        - '/ccertutil'
selection3:  # missing space after the /c
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'cmd.exe /c'
        - 'cmd /c'
filter1:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'cmd.exe /c '
        - 'cmd /c '
condition: 1 of selection* and not 1 of filter*
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*cmd.exe/c*", "*\\cmd/c*") OR CommandLine IN ("*/cwhoami*", "*/cpowershell*", "*/cschtasks*", "*/cbitsadmin*", "*/ccertutil*") OR CommandLine IN ("*cmd.exe /c*", "*cmd /c*") NOT (CommandLine IN ("*cmd.exe /c *", "*cmd /c *"))
